source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Document all safety violations observed.
3. List any non-compliance issues found.
4. Identify unsafe work practices.
5. Record incomplete or inadequate safety documentation.
6. Note missing safety equipment or poorly maintained equipment.
7. Highlight lack of proper signage and labeling.
8. Document instances of non-usage or improper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
9. Record employee training gaps or inadequate safety training programs.
10. Note any lack of emergency preparedness, including evacuation plans, emergency drills, first aid availability, or fire safety equipment.
11. Encapsulate all findings in a concise report.
12. Make sure to reference relevant safety standards, laws, and regulations that were not adhered to, including the specific sections, codes or guidelines.
13. Provide a detailed overview of the assessment, clearly outlining the scope of the audit and the methods used.
14. Develop recommendations to address the areas of non-compliance.
